rootCause: applyClip only followed child clip-path and ignored clipPath resource own property; previously painted regions outside the required whole-silhouette intersection.
fix: Intersect each resource in the original target user space and object box, preserving transforms only on that resource contents. Existing child clipping, unions, cycle and 64-level guards retained.

sources.finding: The resource own clip intersects its full child silhouette; child clips compose before sibling union. Units describe the contents of the resource.
PaintChildren passes aClippedFrame/aMatrix unchanged to the clip that clips this clipPath; GetClipPathTransform uses that original clipped frame for units.
Recursive resource clipping retains reference_box and reference_box_object; resource transforms do not accumulate down the reference chain.
